description: The activity on screen (resumed) and which instance of it this is: instanceId is the Activity object's identity hash (from `dumpsys activity top`), new whenever Android recreates the activity in the same process (configuration change, "Don't keep activities") and unchanged when the app only went to the background and came back; pid is the app's process. A hash is unique only within one process, so recreated is also true when the process changed (process death). recreated and processRestarted compare with the previous call for the same device and app (null on the first call; recreated is also null when another activity is on top than last time). Call it before and after a scenario (HOME and back, set_dont_keep_activities, simulate_process_death, a rotation) as proof of what happened. With packageName, that app must be the one on screen; without it, the last resumed activity `dumpsys activity top` lists (with several on screen, e.g., split screen or another display, pass packageName). Device control.

packageName.description: The app that must be on screen; default: whichever is.

serial.description: adb serial; default: the session device, or the only ready one.
